strings: r_c0 informs m_c that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} healed claw-wound has left {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} leg permanently weakened.
m_c finds that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} a new limp, despite having healed from {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} claw-wound. r_c0 tells {PRONOUN/m_c/object} it's likely permanent.
m_c limps around camp, fully healed from {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} claw-wound but still marked by it for the rest of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} life.
